page_records.head:
Highlights
• Construct granular balls from graph contrastive representations without labels.
• Convert training-time graph structure into so
page_records.tail:
ime graph structure into soft targets for an attribute-only MLP.
• Reﬁne noisy supervision using leave-one-out consensus within granular balls.
• Achieve the highest mean accuracy in 24 of 25 settings with the same MLP.
